study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Mao et al., Developmental Cognitive Neuroscience, 2025
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Mapping early corpus callosum development to identify neurodevelopmental risk

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Sex-specific growth curve models using GAMLSS with a second-order polynomial function of age.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: The  Generalized  Additive  Models  for  Location,  Scale,  and  Shape  (GAMLSS) framework was used to construct growth curves for each corpus callosum morphological  characteristic... selected a second-order polynomial function of age

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Corpus callosum morphometrics, including subregion volumes and midsagittal plane features (area, length, perimeter, circularity).
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Structural MRI data from  295  typically  developing  children  (TDC;  aged  1 -6  years)  were  used  to  model  age-  and  sex-dependent changes in ten morphometric parameters, including subregion volumes and midsagittal plane features.

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age modeled with a second-order polynomial; models built separately by sex (sex-specific growth curve models).
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: We constructed sex-specific growth curve models for each corpus callosum morphological characteristic... we opted for a second-order polynomial function of age
